bullets.text: Underwriting profit margin was 13.3% versus the 4% target; net income increased 18% to $1.65B ($2.10/share, +21%); ROE reached 25.3%, consistent with its five-year average.

The industry achieved four consecutive years of underwriting profitability, and marketing messaging reached an all-time high. Price competition intensified; 2006 industrywide earned premium may be lower than 2005, a 25-year first.

Frequency reductions appeared largely structural and distinguishable from insurance cycles. Expected severity acceleration failed to materialize; management shifted its game plan to focus on reacting quickly to trend changes rather than predicting them.

Added marketing to core capabilities; repositioned the Progressive name across all products, naming agency auto Progressive Drive Insurance; introduced new advertising tagline: "It's about you. And it's about time."

Personal Lines policies +3%, Commercial Auto +7%; deployed Net Promoter Score companywide; shifted focus toward customer retention, aligning 2007 Gainshare incentives to policy count growth and disaggregating new versus renewal policy populations.

Written premiums rose about 1% and earned premiums grew about 3%. Management noted that, though understandable given market conditions, these growth numbers and trends did not meet internal expectations.

Emphasized competitive pricing for existing customers relative to the 96 CR target; short personal auto policy periods, strong sub-segment analytics, and agile operations support rapid pricing adjustments as conditions evolve.

Investment return 7.4%; repurchased 39.1M split-adjusted shares (over 6% of outstanding) averaging under $25; 4:1 stock split completed; debt-to-capital stayed below 15%; established 2007 variable dividend formula tied to Gainshare.

Opened 29 concierge claims centers in 2006, reaching 53 locations across 41 metropolitan markets; national deployment aims to reduce claims-handling frictional costs while leveraging operating scale to competitive advantage.

Blueprinted a plan for the next doubling after five prior doublings; reaffirmed the aspiration of becoming Consumers' #1 Choice for Auto Insurance throughout their insurable lives; highlighted the Core Value of Excellence.
